problem_statement: Collin CAD publishes its appraisal roll as an Access database whose NUMERIC columns are a packed binary representation. The repository has no decoder for that representation, so no Collin value can be read exactly.
desired_outcome: An adapter-local decoder that turns every supported Access NUMERIC representation into an exact Decimal, plus a typed Collin source record and dual current/certified observations, with no production release API and no DAG integration.
assumptions: Synthetic fixtures are authored independently of the decoder under test.
Collin structural metadata is reviewed before it is treated as approved.

planning_decisions.decision_text: Access NUMERIC is decoded from its packed sign, scale, and multiword magnitude into Decimal directly, never through binary floating point. Representations outside the supported set fail closed with a bounded diagnostic.

The Collin structural contract is a deterministic fingerprint over reviewed column names and physical types; a missing, duplicate, renamed, or type-incompatible structure fails closed rather than being coerced.

Current and certified releases produce distinct adapter-layer observations carrying exact values with their source year, status, and row provenance; physical rows are preserved without account roll-up.
Lexical and identifier validation is adapter-local, diagnostics are bounded, and the typed Collin source record stays county-specific so no vendor-neutral abstraction is duplicated here.

task_slices.title: Implement the exact Access NUMERIC decoder
task_slices.description: Decode the packed sign, scale, and multiword magnitude into Decimal without binary floating-point conversion, and cover it with independently authored literal vectors.

task_slices.title: Implement the structural fingerprint and typed Collin source record
task_slices.description: Add the deterministic structural fingerprint, identifier validation, bounded diagnostics, and the county-specific typed source record, failing closed for every structure the contract declares incompatible.

task_slices.title: Emit distinct current and certified observations
task_slices.description: Building on tasks 1.1 and 1.2, emit distinct current and certified adapter-layer observations with exact values and approved year, status, identifier, and row provenance, preserving every physical row.

task_slices.title: Add adapter contract tests and engineering documentation
task_slices.description: Covering tasks 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3, document fixture provenance, malformed-input behaviour, dual-release semantics, row preservation, licensing, compatibility limits, and explicit non-production status.

requirements.title: Decode supported Access NUMERIC values exactly
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter SHALL decode every supported Access NUMERIC representation into an exact Decimal value without binary floating-point conversion.

scenarios.name: Decode signed scaled multiword value
given: an independently authored supported NUMERIC fixture
then: the exact reviewed Decimal value is returned

requirements.title: Refuse unsupported or malformed NUMERIC representations
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter MUST NOT substitute a null, float, partial record, or raw source value when a NUMERIC representation is malformed or unsupported; it SHALL fail with a bounded diagnostic.

scenarios.name: Reject an unsupported scale marker
given: a fixture whose scale marker is outside the approved set
then: a bounded diagnostic naming the unsupported marker is raised
no record is emitted for the row

requirements.title: Fingerprint the reviewed Collin structure deterministically
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter SHALL compute a deterministic structural fingerprint over the reviewed column names and physical types, and MUST reject any missing, duplicate, renamed, or type-incompatible structure.

scenarios.name: Reject a renamed column
given: a source whose reviewed column has been renamed
scenarios.when: the adapter computes the structural fingerprint
then: the fingerprint does not match the approved contract
parsing stops before any row is decoded

requirements.title: Emit distinct current and certified observations
requirements.normative_rule: The Collin adapter SHALL emit distinct current and certified observations carrying the exact decoded value, source year, release status, and row provenance, and SHALL preserve every physical row without account roll-up.

scenarios.name: Preserve repeated physical rows across both releases
given: a synthetic source containing repeated prop_id values
both a current and a certified release
then: the physical row count is unchanged
each observation carries its own release status and row provenance
no deduplication or aggregation by prop_id or geo_id occurs

requirements.title: Keep shared release parsing owned by issue 43
requirements.normative_rule: This change MUST NOT introduce a production release-processing API, a Collin DAG integration, persistence or publication, or any duplicate vendor-neutral source-record abstraction; those remain owned by issue 43.

scenarios.name: No shared abstraction is added county-locally
given: the adapter package after this change
scenarios.when: the repository dependency direction is inspected
then: no vendor-neutral source-record type is defined in the county module
no DAG or service entry point references the Collin decoder

risks: An Access NUMERIC representation outside the reviewed set could appear in a future release.
security_privacy_considerations: Fixtures are synthetic; no production Collin extract is committed.
migration_compatibility_concerns: The decoder is additive and reads no existing persisted value.

evidence_citations.excerpt: Access NUMERIC columns are stored as a packed sign, scale, and multiword magnitude.
The reviewed Collin column set and physical types define the structural contract.
Collin publishes both a current and a certified release each cycle.
Shared bounded release parsing and vendor-neutral records are owned by issue 43.
Adapter documentation must state non-production status and fixture provenance.
